name: Raj Dhiman
heroTitle:
Somewhere between

heroSubtitle: Working across images, stories, interfaces, intelligent systems, and machines.
premiseTitle: A practice shaped by curiosity—moving between the poetic and the precise.
premiseCopy: I photograph what disappears, write what can’t be photographed, and engineer systems that make speculation tangible.
bio: My work moves between photography, fiction, design, computer science, AI/ML, and robotics.
I study computer science, but I think of code as one material among many. A camera, a sentence, an interface, and a machine each reveal different truths about attention.
My photographs have accumulated over 3 million views. Beside technical engineering, I write fiction and research notes exploring how machines perceive and interact with our world.
I am less interested in being “multidisciplinary” as an identity than in following a question until it asks for a different tool.
